##### Project general facts

Verdana Residence 2 is a contemporary residential complex offering a blend of modern design and serene views. The development features a multi-storey building with studios and 1-bedroom apartments. The architecture emphasizes a light colour scheme and functional layouts, designed to meet international standards.

Amenities include landscaped gardens, gyms, pools for both adults and children, playgrounds, a running track, and bike paths. Residents also benefit from indoor and outdoor recreation areas, covered parking, barbecue areas, a lobby, concierge service, 24-hour security, and video surveillance. The project is developed by Reportage Properties within Dubai Investment Park.

Interiors feature modern Italian designs with fully tiled bathrooms and kitchens boasting Italian cabinets and countertops. Residences include double-glazed windows, satellite master antennas, fiber optic internet access, and central air conditioning, along with built-in wardrobes and vanity units. The residences are delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Investments Park (DIP) is a strategically planned, integrated industrial, commercial, and residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Spanning over 2,300 hectares, DIP is known for its comprehensive infrastructure and diverse offerings that cater to a wide range of business and lifestyle needs.

As a thriving business hub, Dubai Investments Park hosts an array of industries, including manufacturing, logistics, technology, and service sectors. The park's state-of-the-art facilities, advanced infrastructure, and convenient location make it an attractive destination for local and international businesses alike.

The community is planned with a strong focus on sustainability and green spaces. Parks, landscaped gardens, and recreational facilities are seamlessly integrated, offering residents a balanced and active lifestyle. DIP's strategic location near major highways and transportation networks ensures easy connectivity to other parts of Dubai.
